current_evidence: The council's Local Validation Checklist page links only this January 2020 document and says the revised checklist 'will be in force from Monday 10th February 2020', following consultation Aug-Sep 2019 and Cabinet on 22 January 2020; a web search found no newer list.

issues.detail: List date 2015-11-01 is the date of the PREDECESSOR document, not this one. The linked list is the January 2020 Local Validation Criteria, in force from 10 February 2020.
issues.evidence: Document: 'This Local Validation Criteria document has been updated from its predecessor of 2nd November 2015'; page: 'will be in force from Monday 10th February 2020'

issues.detail: Many local items are not captured at all. These are: Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment (11; development affecting protected aerodrome surfaces/navigation, lighting/solar that could distract pilots, landscaping increasing bird hazard), Essential Rural Workers Dwelling Assessment (12; rural worker dwellings in Green Belt), National Design Guide/Building for Life Statement (14; major residential), Character Assessment (15; material impact on local character incl. Arden landscape, canal, rail), CIL Question Form (16; all CIL-liable applications), Security Considerations Assessment (17; major, or significant crime risk), Heritage Statement (21; any application affecting heritage assets or settings), Land Contamination Assessment (22; additional floorspace where contamination known/suspected), Meeting Housing Needs (Affordable Housing) Statement (25; all major residential), Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment (26; major residential, 50-55 dBA+ or within 250m of industrial area), Parking and Access Plan (27; new/amended parking or access), Planning Statement (28; all major incl. major change of use), Waste Audit (38; major and flatted schemes below major threshold).

Householder is marked '(none)', yet several local items apply to all applications including householder. These are Parking and Access Plan (27), Trees/Arboricultural Implications Assessment (35; trees on or immediately adjacent to the site), Site level drawings (10; levels vary >0.3m), Heritage Statement (21), Ecology (bat survey for roof-void works, 18) and FRA in Flood Zones 2/3 (20).
issues.evidence: Item 27: 'All applications with new or amended parking or access arrangements'; item 35: applications with trees on or immediately adjacent to the site

issues.detail: Several other application types are wrongly marked '(none)'. Works to trees: item 36 requires a Tree Works Specification (and structural survey) for works to a TPO/conservation-area tree. Prior approval: item 32 Telecommunications covers all mast/antenna applications, and item 35 covers prior notifications for demolition affecting trees. Outline/Reserved matters: FRA, AQA, Ecology, Transport, Affordable Housing, Noise, etc. are framed as 'major development'/'all applications' and are not limited to full. The ~19 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' rows reflect the same misplacement.
issues.evidence: Item 36 'Tree Works Specification (and Structural Survey): works to a protected tree'

issues.detail: The Listed building consent rows have Photographs and Schedule of Works only. They lack the Heritage Statement (item 21) and the Design and Access Statement, which item 6(iii) requires for all LBC applications.
issues.evidence: Item 6 DAS: '(iii) Listed Building Consent applications'

issues.detail: The 'Retail / Town Centre Impact Assessment' trigger is actually the Structural Survey text (item 31, re-use of a building in the Green Belt). The real trigger for item 30 is a sequential test for main town centre uses outside an existing centre and not in line with the Local Plan, and an Economic Impact Assessment for town centre uses over 2,500 sqm or likely to cause significant adverse impacts.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'Town centre uses are defined in the glossary of the NPPF. 31 Structural Survey Development that involves the re-use of a building within a Green Belt location...'

issues.detail: The Lighting Assessment trigger merges two table rows: Lighting (24) and Meeting Housing Needs (25). It wrongly implies 'All major residential development' is a lighting trigger. The lighting trigger is only 'developments proposing or including significant new or amended external lighting'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: '24 25 Lighting Assessment Meeting Housing Needs (including Affordable Housing) Statement All developments proposing... All major residential development...'

issues.detail: Key thresholds are missing from Air Quality, FRA/SuDS and DAS. Air Quality gives only 'Others will need a full AQA...'; the source trigger is background levels >=90% of the objective, within 10m of a road with 10,000+ vehicles/day or a pollutant source, EIA development, or 300+ parking spaces. FRA/Drainage excerpts describe content only; the trigger is all major, 1ha+ in FZ1, FZ2/3, or a critical drainage area. DAS has no trigger; the source requires it for major development, conservation area/WHS schemes of 1+ dwelling or 100 sqm+, and LBC.
issues.evidence: Item 13 Air Quality; item 20 FRA; item 6 DAS

issues.detail: Fragment or garbled triggers. Archaeology is 'to include Archaeological Statement if required).'; in the source, archaeology sits within the Heritage Statement (21). Viability is 'accompanied by a viability assessment (see below).'; the trigger is where policy-compliant development is not proposed for viability reasons. Telecommunications is 'plus an ICNIRP certificate or signed declaration.' Open space is 'recreation grounds, play space...'; the trigger is major commercial/residential or any loss of open space. Ecology includes a URL fragment ('nce/natural-environment') and is cut off.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Ecology trigger: '...Bat survey required for demolition... nce/natural-environment Circular 06/2005... Required (i) major development as defined in artic'

issues.detail: The 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' row's trigger is about waste-management-facility proposals completing a form section. The local requirement is the Waste Audit (item 38) for major development and other significant waste-generating schemes such as flatted development below the major threshold.

The 'Gypsy & Traveller information' row is a rule about wording the application description (number of homes/plots/pitches), not a supporting-document requirement. The Block plan row's excerpt is table-header boilerplate ('Requirement Block/Site Plan Types of application that require this information Policy Driver Guidance All Applications...') and is a national requirement for all applications, not a Full-only local one.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'for gypsies, travellers or travelling show people, the description of the proposal must include the number of homes, plots or pitches.'

issues.detail: Drawing standards contains three near-identical 'Must be drawn to a recognisable scale ... @paper size ref ... linear scale bar' items with different example scales, and one item ends with a stray fragment '\uf0b7 \uf0b7 9.'.

summary: The link is the current January 2020 Local Validation Criteria (in force 10 Feb 2020), but Grokbot dated it to the 2015 predecessor. Extraction captured under half of the 38 items (missing Aerodrome Safeguarding, CIL form, Security, Noise, Parking & Access, Heritage Statement, Affordable Housing, Waste Audit, etc.), wrongly shows Householder and Works to trees as having no local requirements, and has several mismatched triggers.
